reviews.text: This starter kit is perfect for trying the Yuja Niacin line. The products feel lightweight and refreshing on the skin. With regular use, my skin looks brighter and more even, and dark spots appear less noticeable. It didn’t irritate my sensitive skin and provides good hydration. A great set for beginners and travel, and I’m happy with the results so far.
reviews.zh: 呢套入門套裝好啱用嚟試 Yuja Niacin 系列。產品用喺皮膚上感覺輕盈、清新。持續使用之後，我嘅皮膚睇落更亮、更均勻，色斑都冇咁明顯。佢冇刺激我嘅敏感皮膚，保濕效果都好好。適合新手同旅行用，到目前為止，我對效果都好滿意。

reviews.text: I wanted to try this kit after an IG skincare influencer raved about the toner for post acne marks and brightening effects. I've been suffering from very bad hormonal breakouts around my mouth/chin area for months and the acne marks will not fade with spot/scar gels, vitamin c & using spf. I've been using the kit only in the mornings for almost 2 weeks and I can see that my acne marks had lighten up a bit and overall, complexion looks more brighter. I will continue using this kit until it's out and order full size products.
reviews.zh: 我係睇咗一個 IG 護膚網紅大力推薦呢個系列嘅爽膚水，針對痘印同提亮效果，之後先決定試呢套。我嘅嘴巴／下巴周圍好多個月都有好嚴重嘅荷爾蒙痘，痘印就算用祛痘／祛疤膠、維他命 C 同擦防曬都淡唔到。我得咁早上用呢套，差唔多用咗兩個星期，見到痘印淡咗少少，整體膚色都亮咗。我會繼續用到用完，然後買全尺寸產品。

reviews.text: I think it’s good that they have a starter set for this series. First of all the packaging attracted me from the bright yellow color. It gives me the feeling of a nice citrus smell and I wasn’t disappointed! They all smell so nicely like Yuya so fresh! 🍋
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢個系列有入門套裝係好嘅。首先，我畀個鮮黃色嘅包裝吸引咗。佢俾人一種好好聞嘅柑橘香味嘅感覺，而我都冇失望！佢哋全部都好似柚子咁好聞，好清新！🍋

reviews.text: I've had hyperpigmentation from scarring for ages and this product really cleared up my acne scars! It leaves my face feeling much brighter and smells so good (refreshing citrus scent). Even though it's a travel kit, each container actually contains a lot of product and I've been using it for a while
reviews.zh: 我因為疤痕留低嘅色素沉澱好耐，呢款產品真係幫我淡咗痘疤！用完我面感覺亮咗好多，香味都好好聞（清新柑橘香）。雖然係旅行裝，但每個小樽其實都有好多產品，我已經用咗一段時間。

reviews.text:
Hi guys, so I am a medium tan brown skinned South-Asian and I’ve tried this for nearly 2 months now, my friend bought me one and I purchased another one because I noticed it actually works, but slowly, it is more of a brightener and dark spot fader than a skin lightener, don’t get them confused.
Let me break it down for you - for spot scars on the forehead and cheeks it has lightened them up and faded them, for overall skin I would say it is more radiant and slightly brighter (I guess because it looks even) and finally for my chin (sadly being South-Asian means the chin is darker, it has brightened slightly but not to the extent I want, so I will continue to use and might try out some stronger products for that).
reviews.zh:
大家好，我係中等偏深啡色皮膚嘅南亞人，我用咗呢款差唔多兩個月。我朋友買咗一支畀我，之後我又再買咗一支，因為我發現佢真係有效，只係效果慢慢嚟，佢較似提亮同淡化色斑，而唔係美白，唔好搞混。
我同大家逐樣講：額頭同面頰嘅斑痕，佢就淡咗同變淺咗；整體皮膚，我覺得佢比較有光澤、稍為亮啲（我估係因為膚色變得均勻）；至於下巴（好可惜，我係南亞人，下巴本身都會深啲），佢有稍為提亮，但未去到我想要嘅程度，所以我會繼續用，可能之後會試吓更強啲嘅產品去針對下巴。

reviews.text: I am actually hesistant to use skin care products and this SOME BY MI just removed my fear that could destroy my face. I love the citrus smell and how it reacts to my skin. I am on my 12th day as of the writing and will definitely update you once completed my 30days Journey with Yuja Niacin by SOME BY MI
reviews.zh: 我其實一直都好怕用護膚品，怕會弄壞我張面，但係 SOME BY MI 呢款就令我嘅擔心消失咗。我好鍾意佢嘅柑橘香味，同埋佢喺我皮膚上嘅反應。寫呢段嘢嘅時候，我已經用咗 12 日，等我完成 SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin 嘅 30 日旅程之後，一定會再更新畀大家。

reviews.text: I used this after summer and in just a few weeks my skin start to brighten up again and i really love the lemon scent! AFTER 30 DAY I STILL HAVE THE PRODUCTS AND STILL USING IT! Im going to buy this again! Highly recommended ☺️
reviews.zh: 夏天過後用呢款，只係幾個星期，我嘅皮膚就開始再亮返。我好鍾意檸檬香味！30 日之後我仲有產品，而且仲繼續用緊！我會再買！非常推薦 ☺️

reviews.text: I have sensitive skin, though a fair tone. Since I was in my teens maybe around 14 or 15 I started getting freckles, which I didn't like and wanted to get rid of those. 25 years back I was not knowing what freckles are. Never tried anything new, as I thought if it would suits me. Eventually, my skin started to age early with wrinkles and open pores. Tried many products, but all in vain. Then one day my friend recommended me this 30-day starter kit, and now I am loving this. My skin texture is smooth, wrinkles have reduced a lot, skin tightened with reduced open pores. I am getting compliments for my skin texture and tone. I use it daily as part of my morning skincare regime. Would surely recommend this to people with sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 我皮膚敏感，但係膚色偏白。由十幾歲、大約 14、15 歲開始，我開始長雀斑，我唔鍾意，所以一直想除走佢哋。25 年前，我未識雀斑係咩。我從來都冇試過任何新嘅嘢，因為我擔心唔啱我。最後，我嘅皮膚開始提早老化，有皺紋同毛孔粗大。我試過好多產品，但全部都白做。之後有一日，我朋友推薦我呢套 30 日入門套裝，而家我好鍾意。我嘅皮膚質地變得幼滑，皺紋減咗好多，皮膚緊緻咗，毛孔都縮咗。我嘅皮膚質地同膚色都有人讚。我每日早上都將佢當成護膚流程嘅一部分去用。我一定會推薦畀敏感肌嘅人。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
